title: Modularized Networks for Few-shot Hateful Meme Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's accuracy and AUCROC in detecting misogynistic memes using the MAMI (Multimedia Automatic Misogyny Identification) dataset, as well as qualitatively analyzing its generated explanations for gender-targeted hateful memes.

Evaluating the model's accuracy and AUCROC on the Facebook Hateful Meme (FHM) dataset, which includes synthetic memes specifically designed to target vulnerable groups based on race and other protected attributes.
Qualitative case studies assessing the model's ability to correctly classify and generate contextual explanations for memes targeting religious identities (e.g., memes mocking Islam).
Qualitative case studies examining the model's capacity to classify and interpret the underlying hateful rationale of memes that dehumanize immigrants or target specific nationalities.
